_comment: Dashboard form for this poster. Read by studio/dashboard/dashboard.py; flags must match make.py's argparse. '@themes' and '@sizes' are expanded by the dashboard from studio/themes/ and posterlab.chrome.SIZES so the form never drifts from the code.

schema.label: Address
schema.help: Street / area to centre the sheet on (geocoded via Nominatim).

schema.label: Framed radius (m)
schema.help: How far around home the sheet frames. A child walks a few streets; at 400 m a house still prints wide enough to see.

schema.label: Fetched radius (m)
schema.help: Box actually fetched from Overpass. Blank = framed radius × 1.5. Capped at 1000 m.

schema.label: Lift the radius cap
schema.help: Fetch buildings over a box wider than the cap. One comparison render only — it is a heavy Overpass query.

schema.label: Mode
schema.help: standard = data only · poster = data + render · fresh = refetch + render.

schema.label: Theme
schema.help: Lantern is the night theme; Ink prints the same sheet on cream. Or 'All themes'.

schema.label: Layout
schema.help: panel = framed map + bordered log · band/sheet/ledger = map bleeds to the paper edge, writing off the map · bonus = the standalone spotting game, no map · all = render every one.

schema.label: Size
schema.help: The sheet is printed at home, so A4 and Letter are the sizes that matter.

schema.label: Orientation
schema.help: Portrait by default. The bleed layouts' band and column fractions are tuned for it.

schema.label: Night
schema.help: The date printed on the sheet, e.g. 31 October 2026.

schema.label: Write PNG preview
schema.help: Needed to show thumbnails on this dashboard.

schema.label: Assemble digital ZIP
schema.help: Bundle PDFs + how-to + licence into a download ZIP.
